Bug_Title: CN: Super method is annotated with @OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper, but the overriding method isn’t calling the super method. (OVERRIDING_METHODS_MUST_INVOKE_SUPER)
Bug_Details: Super method is annotated with @OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper, but the overriding method isn't calling the super method.
Bug_Explanation: Super method is annotated with @OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper, but the overriding method isn't calling the super method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the `showBug` method of the `BuggyCode` class, which in turn calls the overridden method `methodToOverride` in `SubClass` which is not calling the super method. This violates the rule 'Super method is annotated with @OverridingMethodsMustInvokeSuper, but the overriding method isn't calling the super method'. The bug is triggered at the call to `subClass.methodToOverride()` in `BuggyCode.SubClass`.
